title: Reduce desktop runtime diagnostic overhead
changes: Hoist tracing configuration out of native dispatch and filter unrelated diagnostic addresses early, preserving guest behavior and cache ABI (commit 0f46623).
Correct the optional native-observer test loader for TinyCC relocatable output and add a repeatable Windows runtime benchmark.
validation: 190 Windows tests passed through Wine; 159 Linux core tests passed serially before and after.
Framebuffers and OAM matched over 6,000 replay frames; three timed runs after 120 warmup frames gave median 16.043990 to 4.092949 ms/frame (74.49% reduction under Wine).
limitations: Wine environment lookup overhead can amplify the result; native Windows speed and AI-turn performance remain unmeasured.
The baseline parallel core suite has failures caused by shared display globals.
